summary.name: GNU Mailman
summary.one_liner: GNU Mailman is a mailing list manager for electronic mail discussion lists and e-newsletters, with its project home listed at list.org.
use_cases: managing subscribers to a group email
summary.what_it_does: The page is a GitLab group page for GNU Mailman, linked to http://www.list.org. It is listed in awesome-selfhosted under Communication - Email - Mailing Lists and Newsletters, where it is described as a tool to manage electronic mail discussion and e-newsletter lists. The listing notes the source is GPL-3.0 and written in Python. The page text itself shows only an empty group with no subgroups or projects and no feature details.
caveats: The GitLab page itself shows no subgroups or projects and contains little product detail
Platform support is not stated on the page
